constructionPlansPlacementDescription:
Building Plans are placed on two rings around (0|0), with a predefined count on each ring.
Calculation:
At the start radius of rings are constant. Building Plans are placed equally on each ring, with one degree offset from zero degrees. Then preliminary XY coordinates are calculated from degrees and radius. Next these coordinates are scaled to place the rings within the zone habited by players. Scaling factor is calculated by distance from (0|0) where a new player would be placed. Then minimum distance is added, and then divided by a quotient.
constructionPlansSummandForRawGrades: degree offset for one placement ring
constructionPlansSummandForScalingFactor: Minimum distance to calculate scaling factor

These messages are going to be picked up and processed on this world once in an hour by cron60. So you need to wait for full hour or run cron60 manually.</br>
WARNING! Using this will cause the user to be banned or even deleted with a fake botdetection message. Use only for testing purposes!
